question: Within a single domain, at a strict pre-answer cut, do Ouro-RLTT hidden states predict final success beyond length/logprob/metadata baselines?
scope: read-only weights; one bounded GPU recapture; external verifier labels only; frozen Ouro; no checkpoint changes; no S3A

verdict_rationale.within_domain_specificity: PARTIAL by the task's own >=0.03 rule applied to hidden-minus-best-shortcut (+0.014, in the 0.00-0.02 band, ns). BUT the incremental-validity test (hidden+all minus shortcuts) is +0.066 with group-bootstrap CI [+0.017,+0.114] (significant), and hidden beats length-only by +0.059 (strong-margin point estimate). So: positive-leaning PARTIAL.
verdict_rationale.timing: PASS: strict leakage-controlled pre-answer cut (gsm8k median 163 tok, answer value excluded) predicts at AUROC 0.745, CI excludes 0.5, powered domain, grouped CV.
verdict_rationale.specificity_evidence: HIDDEN_BEATS_SHORTCUTS_WITHIN_DOMAIN via significant incremental validity; caveat: hidden-alone ties the length+logprob composite (not standalone-dominant).
verdict_rationale.weak_claim: NARROW_DEFENSIBLE_CLAIM_ONLY: upgrade from prior SUBSTANTIALLY_SUPPORTED_REQUIRES_MORE_CONTROLS; one powered domain with significant incremental effect supports a narrow caveated proto-introspection claim, not a broad one.

reasoning.source: allenai/ai2_arc ARC-Challenge test (local HF cache, 1172 available)
reasoning.note: budget-capped; UNDERPOWERED (<150); pre-answer front-loaded median 14 tok

recapture.preanswer_cut: text before min(FINAL-ANSWER marker, first occurrence of gold answer value) -> answer value excluded
recapture.labels: external verifier / gold answer only; tap scores never labels

split.hard_rule: no task's samples split across folds

P1_prediction.note: GSM8K powered hidden 0.745; prior deflation was underpower artifact

P2_timing.note: strict leakage-controlled pre-answer cut predicts 0.745 in powered domain

P3_specificity.note: significant incremental validity +0.066; hidden-alone ties composite; one powered domain

P6_cross_domain.note: powered gsm8k + significant underpowered reasoning, same direction

missing_artifacts: MISSING: second powered domain (reasoning reached 105<150, budget-capped, front-loaded) -- consequence: powered specificity rests on one domain
MISSING: Barbados loop-state cross-check -- NOT_RUN, out of scope

next_recommendation.primary: WRITE_PAPER_DRAFT for a narrow, caveated proto-introspection claim (pre-answer hidden states carry readable, significantly-shortcut-independent process-quality signal in a powered domain)
next_recommendation.optional_strengthener: power a second domain (reasoning >=150 tasks, with real pre-answer reasoning) to confirm the incremental effect replicates and lift specificity toward a clean PASS
must_not_claim: hidden dominates trivial predictors (it ties the length+logprob composite)

hard_rules_honored: no Ouro training; no checkpoint modification
external verifier/gold labels only; tap scores never labels
no domain mixing for the primary within-domain result
no task/problem split across train/val/test (task-grouped CV)
shortcut baseline that outperforms hidden NOT hidden: length+logprob composite (0.731) reported prominently; hidden-alone ties it
